title: Bigger Than Any Army
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
A great big army came one day
To fight King Asa’s men,
So many, more than he could count,
What could he do just then?

[Chorus]
No problem is too big for God,
No trouble is too tall,
So when I’m small and need His help,
The Lord will hear my call.

[Verse 2]
He didn’t panic, didn’t run,
He prayed with all his might,
“Lord, only You can help us now!”
God helped them win the fight.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
So close your eyes; if troubles come
Too big for you alone,
Just call on God; He’s always near,
He loves you as His own.

[Chorus]
mood: Brave music. A deep, slow marching pulse moves under the voice, low and steady like a small army standing its ground before a huge one, matching Asa turning to the Lord instead of counting soldiers. The chorus opens broad and strong, a promise bigger than any problem. By the last verse the march eases into a slow, low rocking, and the bigness melts into a close, safe quiet.
